import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 15;
    static final int M = 100005;
    static final int INF = (int) 1e9;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static char[][] c = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] S = new char[N][N];
    static int n, t, tot, sx, sy, st, ed;
    static int[] que = new int[M];
    static int[] fox = new int[M];
    static int[] dist = new int[M];
    static int[][] id = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] dis = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] vis = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] Dis = new int[N][N];
    static Node[] Q = new Node[100005];

    static class Bian {
        int ed, before, flow;
    }

    static class Node {
        int x, y;
        Node(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }

    static List<Bian> s = new ArrayList<>();
    static int k1 = 1;

    static int[] s_ed = new int[M * 2];
    static int[] s_before = new int[M * 2];
    static int[] s_flow = new int[M * 2];

    static int[] head = new int[M];
    static int[] next = new int[M * 2];

    static int[] disArr = new int[M];

    static int maxFlow() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            int flow;
            while ((flow = dfs(st, INF)) != 0) {
                ans += flow;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        int l = 0, r = 0;
        dist[st] = 0;
        que[r++] = st;
        while (l < r) {
            int p = que[l++];
            for (int i = head[p]; i != 0; i = next[i]) {
                if (s_flow[i] > 0 && dist[s_ed[i]] == -1) {
                    dist[s_ed[i]] = dist[p] + 1;
                    que[r++] = s_ed[i];
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[ed] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int num, int flow) {
        if (num == ed) return flow;
        int nowans = 0;
        for (int i = head[num]; i != 0 && flow > 0; i = next[i]) {
            if (s_flow[i] > 0 && dist[s_ed[i]] == dist[num] + 1) {
                int a = dfs(s_ed[i], Math.min(s_flow[i], flow));
                if (a > 0) {
                    s_flow[i] -= a;
                    s_flow[i ^ 1] += a;
                    flow -= a;
                    nowans += a;
                }
            }
        }
        if (nowans == 0) dist[num] = (int) 1e9;
        return nowans;
    }

    static void add(int p1, int p2, int p3) {
        s_ed[k1] = p2;
        s_flow[k1] = p3;
        s_before[k1] = head[p1];
        head[p1] = k1;
        k1++;
        s_ed[k1] = p1;
        s_flow[k1] = 0;
        s_before[k1] = head[p2];
        head[p2] = k1;
        k1++;
    }

    static boolean check(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= n || y >= n || vis[x][y] != 0 || c[x][y] < '0' || c[x][y] > '9') return false;
        return true;
    }

    static void Bfs() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dis[i], 60);
        }
        dis[sx][sy] = 0;
        int l = 1, r = 0;
        Q[++r] = new Node(sx, sy);
        vis[sx][sy] = 1;
        while (l <= r) {
            Node node = Q[l++];
            int ax = node.x, ay = node.y;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[i], ny = ay + dy[i];
                if (check(nx, ny)) {
                    dis[nx][ny] = dis[ax][ay] + 1;
                    if (vis[nx][ny] == 0) {
                        vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                        Q[++r] = new Node(nx, ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void Find(int tx, int ty, int idx) {
        int l = 1, r = 0;
        Q[++r] = new Node(tx, ty);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(vis[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(Dis[i], 60);
        }
        vis[tx][ty] = 1;
        Dis[tx][ty] = 0;
        while (l <= r) {
            Node node = Q[l++];
            int ax = node.x, ay = node.y;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[i], ny = ay + dy[i];
                if (check(nx, ny)) {
                    Dis[nx][ny] = Dis[ax][ay] + 1;
                    if (vis[nx][ny] == 0) {
                        vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                        Q[++r] = new Node(nx, ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Dis[i][j] <= t && S[i][j] > '0' && S[i][j] <= '9' && Dis[i][j] <= dis[i][j]) {
                    add(idx, id[i][j] + tot, INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer stz = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(stz.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(stz.nextToken());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            c[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            S[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        boolean foundZ = false;
        for (sx = 0; sx < n; sx++) {
            for (sy = 0; sy < n; sy++) {
                if (c[sx][sy] == 'Z') {
                    foundZ = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (foundZ) break;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                id[i][j] = ++tot;
            }
        }
        st = 2 * tot + 1;
        ed = st + 1;
        Arrays.fill(head, 0);
        k1 = 1;
        s.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < M * 2; i++) {
            s_ed[i] = 0;
            s_before[i] = 0;
            s_flow[i] = 0;
        }
        Bfs();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (c[i][j] > '0' && c[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(st, id[i][j], c[i][j] - '0');
                    Find(i, j, id[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (S[i][j] > '0' && S[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(id[i][j] + tot, ed, S[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxFlow());
    }
}
